history.steps: Implemented Telegram OTP Password Recovery for Staff; Integrated resetPasswordWithOTPAction; Updated LoginPage UI with dual recovery methods.
history.message: Dual-Channel Password Recovery: Implemented Telegram OTP as a primary alternative to email password resets; added secure resetPasswordWithOTPAction to verify identity and update Firebase Auth credentials via Telegram handshake.

history.steps: Fixed ReferenceError in OTP verification; Implemented configurable OTP validity via ResourceSettings.
history.message: Auth Stability: Resolved ReferenceError in portal OTP verification logic; Added 'portalOtpValidityMinutes' to ResourceSettings for customizable session expiry (defaults to 5 mins); Optimized OTP regeneration to ensure a fresh code is dispatched on every request.
